description: This file defines the MBPackageTree class for managing and rendering a package tree in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder module. It includes methods for populating the tree structure, fetching data, and integrating with other components such as Tree and Node classes.

classes.name: MBPackageTree
classes.description: Class responsible for creating and managing a hierarchical package tree structure in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the tree and populates it with nodes from the ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the package tree, 'Packages'.

methods.name: populateTree
methods.description: Recursively populates the tree structure with nodes, setting properties and handling child nodes.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Returns the tree nodes as an array for rendering.

methods.name: fetchNodes
methods.description: Returns raw node data from the tree.
